parameters.name: EncryptCertificate
parameters.description: The content of the SM encryption certificate.

parameters.name: EncryptPrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key content of the SM encryption certificate.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: SignCertificate
parameters.description: The signing certificate content of the SM certificate.

parameters.name: SignPrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key content of the SM signing certificate.
